# Veqtor v0.5.0 Alpha

Veqtor is a local MCP server for verifiable Word negotiation evidence and tracked edits.

This release adds author drafting in one working DOCX: tracked changes under a configured name, repeated editing of an own pending insertion, reading and adding comments, and updating or deleting supported own comments. Same-file saves retain an exact backup and check that the source has not changed since preflight.

The fourteen-tool MCP surface is `veqtor.mcp.v0.5.0`. Existing document and saved-position tools retain their contracts. The macOS extension asks for the author name and comment initials. Match the name in Word to continue editing under that author.

Close the document in Word before saving through Veqtor. Supported local filesystems are required; network disks and exFAT are refused. New paragraphs, whole-paragraph structural operations and comment replies are outside this version. Unknown temporary files are retained when ownership cannot be proved. Review final Word files before sending.

Install the exact version from PyPI, or open the macOS MCPB through Claude Desktop. Verify the release assets using `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Existing-user acceptance does not establish first-install success in an untouched user or independence from a developer toolchain. Runtime rollback does not convert saved positions or undo document edits; use the retained document backups when needed.

[Documentation](https://veqtor.pro/docs) · [Known limitations](https://veqtor.pro/limitations) · [Source](https://github.com/JohnDeer-ai/veqtor-mcp)
